snacs_adaptation_notes.txt: SNACS v2.6 annotation notes from authorized examples. Each target receives [scene role, lexical function], with p. prefixes. The scene role reflects the semantic relation in context; the lexical function reflects what the adposition or possessive typically expresses. Examples: 'went to the school' when school is an institution attended: [p.Org,p.Goal] (reviews-247226-0002). 'Each of you': [p.QuantityItem,p.Whole]; 'proud of your contributions': of=[p.Stimulus,p.Topic], consistent with guideline example 'proud of the results'; 'your contributions' (contributions performed by you): [p.Agent,p.Gestalt]; 'throughout the year': [p.Duration,p.Duration] (reviews-080221-0004). 'your money' as owned money: [p.Possessor,p.Possessor] (reviews-165143-0006). 'start out by saying': by=[p.Means,p.Means]; 'pedicures at Lovely Nails': at=[p.Locus,p.Locus]; 'Lovely Nails on Military Road': on=[p.Locus,p.Locus] (reviews-128168-0002). Distinguish agentive possessives from ownership, and institutional role of a location from spatial goal where context supports it.
